verdict.rationale: Docs describe Loops for fine-tuning/RL on supported base models and Training Jobs for custom scripts (Axolotl/TRL), with checkpoints synced and deployable as production endpoints on the same platform via a single CLI command, explicitly closing the loop from fine-tune to serve. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific fine-tune-to-serve workflow beyond vendor docs, and detail on which base models are 'supported' for Loops.
